tpch-duckdb-sf1.0-20260828-953eb39b.why_pinned: Smallest SQL result (22 logical queries), every query at the full 3 measurement passes. Pins the ordinary odd-count median path and the published geomean with no special cases in play.

tpcds-spark-sf10.0-20260823-d5f866d2.why_pinned: The corpus's only PARTIAL pass-count case. Query 95's iter-2 measurement execution failed, leaving 2 usable passes against 3 for its 102 siblings, so this one result carries both the uneven-pass case and the even-count median case.

tpcds-duckdb-sf10.0-20260823-fabf8953.why_pinned: Same cohort (tpcds, sf10) as the spark result above, with all 103 queries at the full 3 passes. The pair is the same-query-set geomean case: under warm_pass_2 the spark run cannot answer query 95, so 95 must leave BOTH sides' geomean, not just spark's.

tpch_skew-datafusion-sf1.0-20260826-b4f7.why_pinned: The TOTAL-failure case, which the pre-repopulation corpus did not contain. Every one of query 18's four executions failed -- all three measurement passes AND the warmup -- so the pipeline published display_ms NULL with timing_exclusion_reason 'missing_timing' and took its geomean over 21 of 22 queries. This result is why the fixture pins valid_query_count separately from logical_query_count: a run's published geomean is not necessarily over all its queries.
